title: Australia plots tougher sunscreen regulation
summary: The Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA) has proposed reforms to sunscreen regulation in Australia to improve consumer confidence in SPF claims

extraction.key_fact: 호주 의약품청이 SPF 표기에 대한 소비자 신뢰를 높이려 선크림 규제 개편안을 내놨다
